correctness.rationale: The relative-rank process yields a 1-dependent bounded indicator array with exactly computed adjacent joint probabilities and negative covariances. Formula (1) is exhaustive because all other covariances vanish. Uniformly convergent rational profiles yield a Riemann integral with an explicit antiderivative and strictly positive limit. One-site gaps between blocks establish an independent triangular array obeying Lindeberg, with discarded variance o(n). The derivative has exactly one positive root. Standalone exact weighted enumeration checks 376 rational identities and inequalities; finite checks are only corroboration.

value.rationale: Growing linear record bias is a parameter regime singled out by the originating 2024 research; existing first-order descent means and permutation limits do not describe its fluctuation scale. The theorem supplies an exact second-order Gaussian law and a sharp nonmonotone phase in uncertainty at a natural positive bias, with a unique variational point; it is mathematically motivated and not a gratuitous slice.
